changes.title: Readable narrow-screen messages
changes.text: Dungeon messages stay above the quickslot page switch on narrow screens.

changes.title: Message and native-input checks
changes.text: Native layout checks include rendered messages; setup closes its own modal and waits for actual touch delivery before checking live previews.

changes.title: Keep verification failures traceable
changes.text: Keep exact APK provenance, unsuccessful native checks, corrected test results and compatible fallback evidence in the preparation records.

commentary: Visual review caught the narrow page switch covering messages after the earlier control-overlap fix. I reserved message space above it and added checks for the rendered text; scoring and gameplay remain unchanged.
